jobs.title: Wealth Advisor, Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Titan

Despite decades of innovation in money, the most important consumer money domain remains largely untouched: wealth management. Legacy Wall Street institutions still dominate private wealth, gatekeeping their services behind extremely high minimums, janky user experiences, and layers of fees. They are, in our opinion, the "final boss" of consumer fintech.

Our belief: every American deserves an elite wealth team navigating their capital, delivered at the cost and speed only humans working in harmony with AI can unlock.

At heart, we're a small pack of hard-working rebels operating at the intersection of engineering craft and high-stakes financial precision. Every person here is a calibrated bet on what we're building next. Our mission is to rebuild what a wealth management firm means, from the ground up, brick by brick, leveraging technology across the entire stack, so that AI lets one wealth advisor deliver what used to take a team, serving clients a Wall Street team never could have reached.

We're backed by a16z and Sam Altman, and currently power over $1 billion in assets under management.

Why Join Titan

For the right person, this will be one of the most rewarding roles they ever have.

  • Legacy-defining vision. Private wealth in every pocket isn't an incremental product. It’s not B2B automation. It’s a “before & after” moment in money.

  • The time is now. LLMs just unlocked what was impossible five years ago: truly personalized wealth management for everyone.

  • Outsized decision making. We're a small team by design. Every hire is precise, every role carries real weight, and your decisions disproportionately shape what we become.

  • Built in person, in the trenches. We're a high-touch, high-tempo group that works side by side. You’ll see our founders working in the trenches with the team everyday.

  • Ownership in every sense. Competitive cash and well-above-market equity. We believe in identifying only exceptional talent and compensating them generously.

  • World-class backing. Investors who share the bold vision: a16z, General Catalyst, Accel, Y Combinator, Sam Altman, Paul Graham, and more.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Wealth Advisor to join our Advisory team. Advisory is key to our mission of increasing our generation’s compound growth rate. We pride ourselves in rethinking established paradigms for the end-to-end investment management experience and pushing the status quo. Our goal is to tech-enable the relationship between client and investment manager, setting clients up for superior investment outcomes and compounding their financial knowledge.


You will work directly with our Director of Wealth Advisory to help bridge Titan’s Investment Management and Product teams, helping drive the most seamless investment experience possible for our clients. You will engage current and prospective clients in discussions focused on the nuances of Titan’s investment offerings, reimagine the wealth management industry from the ground up, participate in bespoke portfolio analysis for clients, create and project-manage investment insights (investment reports/webinars), and intensely collaborate cross functionally (Investment Research, Growth/Marketing, Product/Design, Biz Ops & Strategy) to drive product and revenue growth.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage and grow your book of clients: Take ownership of a portfolio of high-net-worth clients, deepening relationships and increasing Assets Under Management through proactive, value-driven guidance.

  • Deliver exceptional client experiences: Be the trusted advisor clients turn to for financial insights, portfolio strategy, and tailored solutions that align with their goals.

  • Identify growth opportunities within existing relationships: Expand wallet share, cross-sell relevant services, and help clients maximize their investment outcomes.

  • Lead high-impact client conversations: Conduct meetings and presentations that showcase our advisory approach and reinforce client trust.

  • Collaborate with internal teams: Partner with operations, investment strategy, and product specialists to ensure seamless delivery of advice and support.

  • Maintain disciplined account oversight: Track client activity, monitor portfolio performance, and ensure reporting and compliance obligations are met.

Qualifications

  • 4-6+ years of experience in Wealth Advisory, Asset Management, Wealth Management, Investment Banking, or other client-facing investment management roles

  • Exceptional written and communication skills along with an acute attention to details

  • Demonstrated ability to handle assorted client questions (including asset allocation recommendations, market perspectives, portfolio positioning, etc.)

  • Comfortable with high volumes of client interactions (e.g., video/phone calls, large-audience webinars)

  • Strong ability to work cross functionally and think creatively to drive product growth

  • Familiarity with investment management principles, asset allocation frameworks, alternative investing, and quantitative analysis

  • Proficiency with basic financial modeling in Microsoft Excel

  • You are fluent with data. You can use data to answer questions, identify opportunities, find insights, measure progress towards goals, and iterate quickly.

  • You make things happen. You are scrappy and find ways to overcome roadblocks with workarounds or tradeoffs.

  • Series 7, 63 and 65 (or Series 7 and 66) required

  • World-class backing. Investors who share the bold vision: a16z, General Catalyst, Accel, Y Combinator, Sam Altman, Paul Graham, and more.

Role Overview

Titan is building its first dedicated sales team, and you'll be the founding member. As the Founding Account Executive (Client Development Advisor), you own the entire journey from first conversation to funded client: discovery, qualification, presenting Titan's wealth management products & advisory, handling objections, closing, and driving account transfers to completion. Once a client funds, you execute a clean handoff to our Wealth Advisory team, who own the relationship from there - and you go win the next one.

You'll work a warm pipeline: Titan generates significant organic inbound leads per month, and our sales cycle is radically faster than legacy RIAs. This is a high-autonomy, high upside role with a clear scoreboard, and your work directly shapes how Titan scales our AUM to $100B and beyond.

What You’ll Do

Pipeline & Prospecting

  • Run daily discovery and introductory calls with warm inbound leads from Titan's website, marketing channels, and referrals

  • Re-engage and nurture prospects who haven't taken next steps; manage structured follow-up cadences.

  • Maintain strict CRM hygiene: stage progression, activity logging, notes, and accurate forecasts.

Sales Execution

  • Lead consultative Zoom calls to understand each prospect's financial goals, and qualify against fit: assets, complexity, timeline, and intent.

  • Present Titan's wealth strategies, advisory services, and planning tools in a compelling, honest, client-first way.

  • Handle questions and objections, drive decisions, and close - then shepherd the transfer/funding process (ACATs, rollovers, ACH transfers) to completion

  • Own your numbers: funded clients, funded assets, conversion rate, and speed to fund.

Handoff Collaboration

  • Execute a documented handoff to the Wealth Advisory team at funding - client goals, sensitivities, and expectations.

  • Share insights with engineering, product, & growth teams on lead quality, objections, and messaging to sharpen the funnel.

Product & Industry Mastery

  • Develop deep fluency in Titan's investment strategies, advisory services, and planning tools.

  • Stay current on trends in wealth management, fintech, and investment strategy to better support and educate prospective clients.

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of full-cycle consultative sales experience - you have been held accountable to closing new business, not just setting meetings.

  • Series 65 (or SIE/Series 7 + 66 equivalent) required.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • A demonstrable track record of meeting or exceeding conversion and revenue targets.

  • Strong discovery and qualification instincts: you ask sharp questions and listen before you pitch.

  • Drive and resilience. We can teach product and process; we can't teach hunger.

  • Clear, confident communication - comfortable discussing markets, portfolios, and financial concepts by phone and video.

  • CRM fluency and pipeline discipline; hygiene is not negotiable.

Role Overview

Titan engineers are building the systems to power a next-generation RIA prepared to scale well beyond our $1B AUM. Working alongside former founders, Google & Meta Engineers We are seeking a Senior Backend / Infrastructure Engineer to help architect, build, and scale the core systems that power our financial platform. You’ll work on our backend services, trading systems, real-time APIs, data pipelines, automated workflows, and infrastructure in ways that are secure, scalable, and resilient. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions will directly affect platform reliability and performance at scale.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Improve and extend the infrastructure that enables trading, account management, transaction processing, and portfolio automation.

  • Ensure high availability, performance, and security across backend systems powering millions of daily operations.

  • Build and enhance internal tools, data pipelines, and system integrations.

  • Extend our devOps/infrastructure to shape CI/CD, deployment automation, observability, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Champion best practices for code quality, system design, testing, and documentation.

  • Mentor junior engineers and drive architectural initiatives across the backend domain.

Qualifications

  • 3 + years of professional experience building backend systems in TypeScript or comparable languages (Node.js preferred).

  • Strong backend fundamentals: APIs, microservices, distributed systems, data stores, caching, messaging systems.

  • Experience with database design (SQL & NoSQL), scaling patterns, performance optimization, and observability.

  • Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure as code.

  • Solid understanding of security practices for backend systems (authentication, authorization, data protection).

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building financial or real-time services.

  • Familiarity with automated portfolio, trading, or financial data systems.

  • Previous ownership of backend infrastructure or mission-critical systems.

  • Experience scaling apps used by tens of thousands of users with high throughput.

  • Implement features end-to-end: frontend UI, backend API integration, data management, and performance optimization.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to partner with product and design teams.

  • Contributions to React or React Native open-source libraries.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Wealth Advisor to join our Advisory team. Advisory is key to our mission of increasing our generation’s compound growth rate. We pride ourselves in rethinking established paradigms for the end-to-end investment management experience and pushing the status quo. Our goal is to tech-enable the relationship between client and investment manager, setting clients up for superior investment outcomes and compounding their financial knowledge.


You will work directly with our Director of Wealth Advisory to help bridge Titan’s Investment Management and Product teams, helping drive the most seamless investment experience possible for our clients. You will engage current and prospective clients in discussions focused on the nuances of Titan’s investment offerings, reimagine the wealth management industry from the ground up, participate in bespoke portfolio analysis for clients, create and project-manage investment insights (investment reports/webinars), and intensely collaborate cross functionally (Investment Research, Growth/Marketing, Product/Design, Biz Ops & Strategy) to drive product and revenue growth.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage and grow your book of clients: Take ownership of a portfolio of high-net-worth clients, deepening relationships and increasing Assets Under Management through proactive, value-driven guidance.

  • Deliver exceptional client experiences: Be the trusted advisor clients turn to for financial insights, portfolio strategy, and tailored solutions that align with their goals.

  • Identify growth opportunities within existing relationships: Expand wallet share, cross-sell relevant services, and help clients maximize their investment outcomes.

  • Lead high-impact client conversations: Conduct meetings and presentations that showcase our advisory approach and reinforce client trust.

  • Collaborate with internal teams: Partner with operations, investment strategy, and product specialists to ensure seamless delivery of advice and support.

  • Maintain disciplined account oversight: Track client activity, monitor portfolio performance, and ensure reporting and compliance obligations are met.

Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Wealth Advisory, Asset Management, Wealth Management, Investment Banking, or other client-facing investment management roles

  • Exceptional written and communication skills along with an acute attention to details

  • Demonstrated ability to handle assorted client questions (including asset allocation recommendations, market perspectives, portfolio positioning, etc.)

  • Comfortable with high volumes of client interactions (e.g., video/phone calls, large-audience webinars)

  • Strong ability to work cross functionally and think creatively to drive product growth

  • Familiarity with investment management principles, asset allocation frameworks, alternative investing, and quantitative analysis

  • Proficiency with basic financial modeling in Microsoft Excel

  • You are fluent with data. You can use data to answer questions, identify opportunities, find insights, measure progress towards goals, and iterate quickly.

  • You make things happen. You are scrappy and find ways to overcome roadblocks with workarounds or tradeoffs.

  • Series 7, 63 and 65 (or Series 7 and 66) required

  • Translate recurring client feedback into clear recommendations for internal teams (Product, Engineering, Ops)

  • A genuine service mindset

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with exceptional attention to detail

  • Calm, empathetic presence when handling complex or sensitive client situations

  • Ability to manage high volumes while maintaining quality and consistency

  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a highly collaborative team

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

  • Familiarity with support tools like Kustomer, Hubspot, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

  • Clients feel supported, informed, and confident throughout every interaction

  • Advisors trust you as a reliable extension of their work with clients

  • Transfers are processed accurately, efficiently, and with minimal friction
